notes: Blogger JSON feed; all 336 posts of 2026 obtained via monthly windows (start-index pagination alone missed 13). Release = post carrying label 'new watches' (313); excluded 23 = industry news, features, interviews, auctions, exhibitions without that label. Brand/model left empty (labels mix brand, collection and topic tags). Article pages not fetched; no spec boxes exist, so refs were extracted by regex from feed body text/img alt where prose says 'reference/ref.' followed by a code containing a digit; refs are partial and only present when mentioned in prose.
